# iarepo — Open Educational Resource Repository

> iarepo.com is a free, open repository of interactive educational resources for teachers worldwide.

## About
iarepo is a platform where teachers can discover, share, and execute interactive educational resources — simulations, tools, AI-generated models, and more. Think of it as "GitHub for Education."

## Key Features
- Interactive simulations from PhET, GeoGebra, Desmos
- HTML5 interactive resources (physics, chemistry, biology, math)
- AI-generated educational models and prompts
- Resource viewer with sandbox execution
- Fork and adapt resources for your own classroom
- REST API for programmatic access

## Categories
- Physics: simulations for mechanics, waves, electromagnetism, thermodynamics
- Chemistry: molecular structures, reactions, pH, states of matter
- Mathematics: graphing, geometry, calculus, linear algebra
- Biology: natural selection, genetics, neuroscience
- General / Tools: LaTeX guides, presentation tools

## Educational Levels
- Primary (ages 6-12)
- Secondary (ages 12-16)
- IB (International Baccalaureate)
- University
- General

## Resource Types
- `html` — Interactive HTML5/JS/CSS resources executed in-browser
- `url` — External simulations (PhET, GeoGebra, Desmos)
- `embed` — Embeddable widgets
- `python` — Python code (Pyodide execution planned)
- `prompt` — AI prompts for educational content generation

## API
- Browse resources: GET https://iarepo.com/api/resources.php
- View a resource: https://iarepo.com/view/{id}
- Search: GET https://iarepo.com/api/resources.php?search=waves
- Filter by category: GET https://iarepo.com/api/resources.php?category=1
- Filter by level: GET https://iarepo.com/api/resources.php?level=secondary

## Sources
All external resources are properly attributed:
- PhET Interactive Simulations (University of Colorado Boulder) — CC-BY-4.0
- GeoGebra — CC-BY-SA
- Desmos — Free for educational use
